questions.prompt: Plot the points (-4, 3) and (2, -5) on the coordinate plane. Then state which point is in Quadrant II.
questions.student_html: Plot the points (-4, 3) and (2, -5). Then state which point is in Quadrant II.
questions.solution: Plot x first and y second. (-4, 3) has negative x and positive y, so it is in Quadrant II.

questions.primary_i_can: Read a graph using its scale.
questions.evidence_job: Read a graph accurately using its scale.
questions.prompt: The graph shows a line. What is the y-value when x = 3? Use the grid scale carefully.
questions.student_html: What is the y-value when x = 3? Use the grid scale carefully.
questions.solution: The line is y = 2x + 1, so at x = 3 the y-value is 2(3)+1 = 7.
